messages:
maya: Quick sync: we need a short, operator-facing definition of "unwrap" during escrow drain for PII tenants. What's the minimal checks list?

raj: Unwrap preconditions: tenant consent present OR legal-exception flag; KEK availability in target region; audit token generated. If any missing -> policy-deadletter.

sophia: Add KMS unwrap TTL: unwrap requests must complete within 2m else fail to avoid long-held plaintext in memory. Also record unwrap request id for audit.

tony: For safety, require a double-ack: control-plane policy ack + HSM unwrap ack before reconciler applies bytes. Metric: unwrap.latency_histogram.

elaine: Operator note: add a canary opt-in per-tenant. For high-PII tenants, require manual approval step in runbook.

ops-bot: Linked runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/escrow-unwrap :information_source:

maya: Fallback path: if unwrap fails repeatedly, do not discard escrow. Instead mark escrow as 'quarantine' and surface to tenant-owner with remediation steps. Only as last resort we support synchronous forward to hosted fallback (explicit SLA hit) when operator opts in.

raj: Also recommend using ULID+region prefix for escrow IDs and include checksum to detect truncation.

sophia: I'll write a minimal policy snippet and examples for KEK unwrap errors (ETA 48h).

tony: I'll propose metric names and pager thresholds (ETA 24h).

elaine: I'll add manual approval toggle and a short CLI snippet to run the unwrap probe in runbook (ETA EOD).

maya: Thanks. Action items captured. Tagging @sophia @raj @tony @elaine for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
